gap: Our ink is split into two tiers and the second one is too weak: headline sits at #0c1a5d (14.5:1) but every line of body and microcopy drops to a desaturated slate-blue #404f8f (7.0:1), which is what makes the page read hazy instead of certain. Wave holds ONE ink, #001b66, at full strength for headline and body alike (14.5:1 both), so collapse our body, microcopy and label greys onto the single navy and let size and weight carry hierarchy rather than lightening the colour.
